why: Checks 1–3 run the CLI and capture the exit status, so must_not item 2 is avoided. Check 4 breaks item 1. Expect line 4 only says "lint(text) in src/index.js is unchanged". The verifier instead requires "the diff is empty (the file is byte-identical to the base)" and fails on "any change to packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js". That limits which files the PR may touch: an edit elsewhere in index.js that leaves lint(text) as it was would fail. The builder brief repeats this with "Do not touch packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js at all (not even whitespace or comments)". The other checks stay close to their lines. Advisory items do not decide PASS/FAIL. Check 1's "non-empty JSON.parse message on one line" can be justified by "as for one file before".
